needs.why_existing_wont_do: delayed_trigger's durations are only this_turn, until_it_fires and once_this_turn (DELAYED_DURATIONS); this_turn ends before any opponent can attack Vraska and until_it_fires would stop after the first creature and never expire. Also needs the trigger to watch combat damage dealt TO the source planeswalker by any creature, binding the damage source for destroy
